description: This file provides a set of functions to control system services using start-stop-daemon. It includes wrappers for starting, stopping, checking, signaling, and reloading services, with environment variable configurations for customization.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to manage service actions such as start, stop, check, and signal, with argument parsing and executable validation.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Wraps the 'service' function with the '-C' option to check if an executable is alive.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the service process, defaulting to USR1, using the 'service -K' command.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service and waits for it to terminate gracefully, escalating to KILL if necessary.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the service by sending the reload signal using 'service -K'.
